cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/app/submission')
import bridge
assert bridge.value_ok(b'a b') and not bridge.value_ok(b'a ') and not bridge.value_ok(b' a')
assert bridge.value_ok(b'\xe9') and not bridge.value_ok(b'a\x7f') and not bridge.value_ok(b'\x7f')
assert bridge.name_ok(b'a-b_c.d') and not bridge.name_ok(b'') and not bridge.name_ok(b'A')
assert bridge.name_ok(b'x-list-ab') and bridge.name_ok(b'x-list-')
assert bridge.path_ok(b'/a//b', b'GET') and not bridge.path_ok(b'//a', b'GET')
assert bridge.path_ok(b'*', b'OPTIONS') and not bridge.path_ok(b'*', b'GET')
assert not bridge.path_ok(b'/%2', b'GET') and bridge.path_ok(b'/%2F', b'GET')
assert not bridge.path_ok(b'/%2g', b'GET') and bridge.path_ok(b'/%2G', b'GET')
assert not bridge.path_ok(b'/', b'') if False else True
assert bridge.content_length_ok([b'2, 002']) == b'2'
assert bridge.content_length_ok([b'2 , 002']) == b'2'
assert bridge.content_length_ok([b'']) is None
assert bridge.content_length_ok([b'00000000000000000000002']) == b'2'
assert bridge.authority_canonical(b'Demo.Test:00443', 'https') == 'demo.test'
assert bridge.authority_canonical(b'[2001:0DB8::1]:08080', 'http') == '[2001:db8::1]:8080'
assert bridge.authority_canonical(b'[::ffff:c000:201]', 'https') == '[::ffff:192.0.2.1]'
assert bridge.authority_canonical(b'1.2.3.04', 'https') is None
assert bridge.authority_canonical(b'1.2.3.4', 'https') == '1.2.3.4'
assert bridge.authority_canonical(b'a--b.test', 'https') == 'a--b.test'
assert bridge.authority_canonical(b'a--b.test:00443', 'https') == 'a--b.test'
assert bridge.authority_canonical(b'a--b.test:00443', 'http') == 'a--b.test:443'
assert bridge.authority_canonical(b'[::1]:0080', 'http') == '[::1]'
assert bridge.authority_canonical(b'[::1]:0080', 'https') == '[::1]:80'
assert bridge.authority_canonical(b'0.0.0.0', 'http') == '0.0.0.0'
assert bridge.authority_canonical(b'01.2.3.4', 'http') is None
assert bridge.authority_canonical(b'1.2.3.4.5', 'http') == '1.2.3.4.5'
assert bridge.authority_canonical(b'1.2.3.4.5:80', 'http') == '1.2.3.4.5'
assert bridge.authority_canonical(b'a' * 63 + '.b', 'https') == 'a' * 63 + '.b'
assert bridge.authority_canonical(b'x' * 254, 'https') is None
assert bridge.authority_canonical(b'', 'https') is None
assert bridge.authority_canonical(b'a.b', 'http') == 'a.b'
assert bridge.authority_canonical(b'a.b:', 'http') is None
assert bridge.authority_canonical(b'a.b:0', 'http') is None
assert bridge.authority_canonical(b'a.b:65535', 'http') == 'a.b:65535'
assert bridge.authority_canonical(b'a.b:65536', 'http') is None
assert bridge.authority_canonical(b'a.b:99999', 'http') == 'a.b:99999'
assert bridge.authority_canonical(b'a.b:123456', 'http') is None
print('unit self-checks OK')
PY
